definitions.explanation: The act of paying careful attention to details and showing consideration for others.

examples.japanese: ホテルの{心配|こころくば}りが{行|い}き{届|とど}いていた。
examples.english: The hotel's attention to detail was thorough.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{心配|こころくば}りができる{人|ひと}だ。
{来客|らいきゃく}への{心配|こころくば}りを{忘|わす}れない。
examples.english: To not forget to show care toward guests.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{心|こころ} (heart) + {配|くば}り (distribution, arrangement) → distributing one's heart = attentive care

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{心配|こころくば}りができる - to be capable of showing care
・{心配|こころくば}りが{行|い}き{届|とど}く - to be thorough in one's attentiveness
・{心配|こころくば}りを{忘|わす}れない - to not forget to show consideration

NUANCE:
{心配|こころくば}り emphasizes the behavioral aspect of showing care—actually doing things to help or accommodate others. It suggests attentive, proactive consideration.

COMPARISON:
・{気遣|きづか}い - concern (often about worry)
・{心遣|こころづか}い - emotional thoughtfulness
・{心配|こころくば}り - attentive care (focus on actions)
・{目配|めくば}り - watchfulness (visual attention)
